categories.main_business_segments: Hoshine Silicon Industry Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the production and sales of silicon-based new materials, focusing on industrial silicon and organic silicon products. The company also engages in the photovoltaic (solar) industry, including polysilicon and photovoltaic components. It has a comprehensive business chain covering industrial silicon, organic silicon, and polysilicon, making it one of the largest and most complete enterprises in China's silicon-based materials industry.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies in silicon material synthesis, including carbothermal reduction in submerged arc furnaces for industrial silicon and catalytic fluidized bed processes for organic silicon monomers. It has mastered the full industrial chain technology for silicon carbide materials, including raw material synthesis, crystal growth, substrate processing, and epitaxial wafer production. The company emphasizes continuous R&D to improve product quality, energy efficiency, and automation, and has developed proprietary technologies for high-purity polysilicon and photovoltaic glass manufacturing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Hoshine Silicon serves key downstream industries such as photovoltaic (solar energy), chemical, electronics, automotive, construction, textiles, and medical sectors. Its products are essential raw materials for polysilicon, organic silicon materials, silicon-aluminum alloys, and other high-tech applications. The company maintains close business relationships with leading enterprises in polysilicon, organic silicon, and silicon alloy industries, with domestic sales concentrated in East China, South China, and Northwest China, and exports mainly to India, South Korea, and the Netherlands.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with major production bases in Xinjiang, Zhejiang, Sichuan, and Yunnan provinces. It has established integrated industrial parks in Xinjiang and Yunnan, leveraging local resource advantages. Overseas sales cover countries including India, South Korea, and the Netherlands. The company also has subsidiaries and operations in Hong Kong and other regions, supporting its international trade and export activities.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hoshine Silicon operates primarily upstream and midstream in the silicon materials supply chain. It produces raw industrial silicon and organic silicon monomers, which serve as key raw materials for downstream polysilicon producers and manufacturers of photovoltaic components and other silicon-based products. The company integrates coal, electricity, and silicon production to form a coal-electricity-silicon industrial chain, enhancing supply stability and cost control.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation and R&D investment, focusing on breakthroughs in key materials and equipment, including silicon carbide substrates and epitaxial wafers. It aims to upgrade production processes, enhance product quality, and expand into emerging fields such as photovoltaic components and high-performance organic silicon products. The company also emphasizes digital transformation, automation, green energy utilization, and carbon footprint certification to support sustainable development and maintain industry leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Hoshine Silicon generates revenue primarily through direct sales of industrial silicon, organic silicon products, and related silicon-based materials. The company employs a direct sales model targeting industrial customers, with sales conducted domestically and internationally. Revenue is derived from product sales contracts, with pricing influenced by raw material costs and market demand. The company also receives government subsidies related to assets and income, which contribute to other income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the largest and most comprehensive silicon-based new materials producers in China, holding a leading position in industrial silicon and organic silicon markets. It competes with other major domestic and international silicon material producers, leveraging its integrated coal-electricity-silicon industrial chain and advanced technology. The company is recognized as a high-tech enterprise and plays a significant role in setting industry standards, maintaining a competitive edge through scale, technology, and resource advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, Hoshine Silicon achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 26.58 billion, representing a 12.37% increase year-over-year. However, net profit attributable to shareholders declined by 49.05% to RMB 2.62 billion, mainly due to decreased product prices. The company’s total assets grew by 55.11% to RMB 83.34 billion, supported by significant investments in new production capacity and industrial projects. The company maintains a strong asset base and continues to expand production capabilities, with a focus on sustainable growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Hoshine Silicon emphasizes its comprehensive industrial chain integration, combining coal, electricity, and silicon production to ensure stable supply and cost advantages. Its advanced proprietary technologies and strong R&D capabilities enable high-quality, high-purity silicon products with superior performance. The company’s geographic positioning leverages resource and energy cost advantages, while its commitment to green development and digital transformation enhances operational efficiency and sustainability. These factors collectively differentiate the company as a leading and innovative silicon materials supplier.
